newsitem.title: ISRAEL: U.S. envoy says he leaving Mideast.
newsitem.headline: U.S. envoy says he leaving Mideast.

text.p: U.S. peace envoy Dennis Ross said on Monday he would leave the Middle East, having failed to break a stalemate in Israeli-PLO talks after 15 days of trying.
"I will be returning to the United States today and I will be consulting with the secretary of state," Ross told a news conference. He declined to discuss details of the negotiations.
He said there were still "delicate issues" to be negotiated.
The talks would continue without him and U.S. diplomats would take part.
"I'm not giving details of the negotiations...We have made progress. We have made more progress in the security area than in the civilian affairs area," Ross said.
"There will be a continuing and active American role...I expect to return when I think the time is right and appropriate," he said.
